title: LearningOS plan-template query response v1
description: The answer to `los plan-template curriculum --json`. It carries a freshly generated study-map starting record, never a copy of an existing plan. The record is validated against the study-map schema before this envelope is printed.

plan_template_version.description: The creation-template version every newly authored plan must carry (system/OPERATOR.md rule 15).

schema.description: The domain schema the record was validated against, so the consumer can name the authority rather than infer it.

plan.description: The generated starting record. Its full shape is owned by the domain schema named above, not restated here — restating it would create the second definition this standardization exists to remove.
